name: cloudy-cli
description: Cloudy in your terminal — chat, one-shot asks, and the coding agent that runs in the folder you are standing in. Same account, models and quota as the web app.
//files: What an install actually needs: the bin, the TUI sources it loads, and the bundled stdio hosts. Tests and build tooling stay out of the tarball, and so do the bundles' source maps — they inline the full source of cloudy-core, which is private.

scripts.//prepublishOnly: dist/ is built, not committed: a published tarball would otherwise ship without the stdio host and `cloudy serve --stdio` would fail on every install.

//devDependencies: cloudy-core is build-time only: src/serve.js and src/import.js import it, and build.mjs bundles both into dist/*.cjs, so an installed copy needs no copy of it.
